source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A model with **FLY**, and any unit it is part of, can fly. Each time such a unit is picked for a [Normal](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), [Fall Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) or **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)**, its player may announce, before moving any model, that it takes to the skies. For that move:

- its maximum distance drops by 2"
- only horizontal travel counts toward the distance each model moves
- its models can pass through any other model and move up, down or across terrain of every category

**[Hover](vsdata:core-ability/hover)** removes the 2" reduction.

flyingUnit.definition: any unit that a FLY model is part of

declaration.when: on every selection of a flying unit for one of the listed moves, ahead of moving any of its models
declaration.name: take to the skies

whileTakingToTheSkies.scope: only the move for which it was declared

eachModelAsItMoves.throughModels: all, including enemy and MONSTER/VEHICLE models

raisedSurfaces.governedBy: 13.06, which lists FLY among the keywords that may end on a raised surface

listStructure.print: two first-level bullets after the conditional lead-in that ends in a colon; three second-level bullets under the per-model item

removesReduction.effect: a unit with it takes to the skies without the 2" reduction
